title: Scalar linearity of product noise
statement: Let $[0m\Omega$ be a finite set, let $[0m\pi$ be a probability mass function on it, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $[0m\rho\in[0,1]$. For every real scalar $c$ and every real-valued function $f$ on $[0m\Omega^n$, the product noise operator that independently retains each coordinate with probability $[0m\rho$ and otherwise resamples from $[0m\pi$ satisfies $T_\rho(cf)=cT_\rho f$.
